hero.title: Integrated solutions for sustainable, inclusive and resilient territories
hero.statement: Restore land. Assess impacts. Act for sustainable development.
hero.lead: SEI supports institutions and development actors in designing and implementing solutions with strong environmental and social impact across Africa.

identity.title: A committed firm serving Africa’s sustainable transformation
identity.ambition: Turn environmental, social and climate challenges into levers for action, peace and resilience for African communities and territories.
paragraphs: Social & Eco Impact (SEI) is a consulting firm specialised in sustainable territorial management, environmental and social assessment, and responses to peace, mobility and climate change challenges in Africa.

SEI supports public institutions, local authorities, international organisations, and technical and financial partners in designing, implementing, monitoring and evaluating high-impact policies, strategies, projects and programmes.

expertiseIntro.title: Three complementary areas of expertise
expertiseIntro.text: Connecting land restoration, impact management and societal resilience to address the complex challenges facing territories.

expertises.title: Land degradation neutrality
expertises.summary: SEI supports public actors and their partners in preventing land degradation, restoring ecosystems and managing natural resources sustainably.
interventions: Territorial planning and sustainable land management
Identification and prioritisation of mining areas to restore
Integration of land degradation neutrality objectives into development policies, strategies and programmes
expertises.impact: Preserve natural capital, restore productive ecosystem functions and sustainably improve people’s living conditions.

expertises.title: Environmental and social assessment and management
expertises.summary: SEI helps manage the environmental and social risks and impacts associated with development policies, projects and programmes.
interventions: Development, implementation and monitoring of environmental and social management plans (ESMP)
Gender mainstreaming and inclusion of vulnerable groups in projects and programmes
Audits, monitoring and evaluation, and environmental and social reporting
expertises.impact: Anticipate risks, strengthen social acceptance and improve the compliance, performance and sustainability of interventions.

expertises.title: Peace, mobility and climate change
expertises.summary: SEI works at the heart of interactions between climate change, pressure on natural resources, human and pastoral mobility, displacement and conflicts over resource use.
interventions: Inclusive agropastoral strategies supporting peaceful coexistence among territorial users
Anticipation and support for population displacement caused by climate and environmental crises
Design and implementation of climate change adaptation strategies
Development of sustainable, inclusive and resilient livelihoods
expertises.impact: Reduce vulnerabilities, prevent tensions and strengthen the capacity of communities and territories to face climate disruption and social and economic change.

valueAdded.text: SEI combines technical expertise, understanding of local dynamics, methodological innovation and stakeholder participation.
